name: Johan Danielsson - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on addressing subcontracting chains and the role of intermediaries in order to protect workers’ rights
part_text:
This report is not a law. It is the European Parliament's set of demands to the European Union's executive body, the Commission. It asks for new rules on companies that pass work down through chains of subcontractors, and on agencies that supply workers. It wants limits on how long these chains can get in risky sectors like building and farming, someone held responsible along the whole chain, and a register of labour agencies. It also asks for more labour inspectors and stronger punishment for exploitation.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It asks the Commission to propose new European Union rules.
- **Who it affects:** Workers in building, farming, cleaning, care and food processing, plus the companies and agencies that hire them.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to act on these requests.
